caption: My fav weeknight pasta 🍝 so easy you won't believe it

transcript.text: Okay so for this pasta, you're gonna need about a pound of spaghetti.
Boil it in heavily salted water, I mean really heavily salted.
While that's going, dice up half an onion and like four cloves of garlic.
In a big pan, heat up two tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the onion first, cook it for about five minutes until soft.
Then add the garlic for another minute, you'll smell it when it's ready.
Add a can of crushed tomatoes, 28 ounces.
Season with salt, pepper, and a teaspoon of dried oregano.
Let it simmer for 15 minutes, it'll thicken up nicely.
Drain your pasta, save some pasta water.
Toss it all together, adding pasta water to loosen if needed.
Finish with a handful of fresh basil and parmesan on top.
